Bill.BriefDescription: Studying options for suspending the waiting week for individuals who are unemployed because of an emergency or disaster.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing the governor to suspend the waitingweek for individuals who are unemployed because of an emergency ordisaster; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The employment security department shallconduct a study of options for suspending the waiting periodrequirement for individuals who are unemployed because of an emergencyor disaster, or otherwise compensating such individuals for lost wages.The department shall also examine ways to mitigate the impacts, if any,of these options on the unemployment compensation system. Thedepartment shall report on its study to the appropriate committees ofthe legislature by December 1, 2008.
